sn35.148:1.2: taṃ suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmīti.
sn35.148:1.3: katamā ca sā bhikkhave, nibbānasappāyā paṭipadā:
sn35.148:1.4: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu cakkhuṃ dukkhanti passati, rūpā dukkhanti passati, cakkhuviññāṇaṃ dukkhanti passati, cakkhusamphasso dukkhoti passati, yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi dukkhanti passati. sotaṃ …pe… ghānaṃ …pe…
sn35.148:1.5: jivhā dukkhāti passati, rasā dukkhāti passati, jivhā viññāṇaṃ dukkhanti passati, jivhāsamphasso dukkhoti passati, yampidaṃ jivhāsamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi dukkhanti passati. kāyo …pe…
sn35.148:1.6: mano dukkhoti passati, dhammā dukkhāti passati, manoviññāṇaṃ dukkhanti passati, manosamphasso dukkhoti passati, yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati. vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi dukkhanti passati.
sn35.148:1.7: ayaṃ kho sā bhikkhave nibbānasappāyā paṭipadāti.
